title: Proofs of Two Conjectures of Alon on Subgraph Counts
summary: All graphs considered are finite with no isolated vertices. Let $N(m,H)$ be the maximum number of subgraphs of a graph $G$ isomorphic to $H$, taken over all graphs $G$ with $m$ edges. Alon proved that $N(m,H)=Θ_H(m^{γ(H)})$, where $γ(H)=(|V(H)|+D(H))/2$ and $D(H)=\max_{S\subseteq V(H)}(|S|-|N_H(S)|)$, and conjectured [Conjecture 1, Isr. J. Math., 1986] that limit of $N(m,H)/m^{γ(H)}$ exists as $m\to\infty$. We prove this conjecture and identify the limit as $λ(H)=Λ(H)/|\operatorname{Aut}(H)|$, where $Λ(H)$ is characterized by a variational problem over finite cores. We also resolve another…
